scope: Offline trace of stock 180-second reset and rapid USB gesture; no live device access in this turn. Mac pair remains seated.

reset180.conditions: Right failure count >=8, right no-reply counter divisible by180, runtime reset-suppression byte clear.
reset180.helper: When Case access is not busy: gates access, saves cached YHM context, checks UART/controller state, configures PB9 output, selects right routing, emits stock train, restores right profile, delays10, changes PB9 to input, applies ordinary output policy, releases busy gate.
reset180.train: 0x0800B678: 103 GPIO/delay actions exactly match prior qualified SRAM waveform.
reset180.gpio: GPIOB bit9 mask0x200 output push-pull no pull speed3 during train; returned to input afterward. This is a routed pulse sequence, not proof of a physical Apollo nRESET connection.

recoveryAssessment.priorProbe: Qualified Case SRAM early-windowed variant already emitted the exact103-action right reset train and sent read-only Ambiq HELLO at nominal0/10/50/250ms after train; zero RX bytes, zero UART errors, exact10-register restoration.
recoveryAssessment.difference: Prior probe retains communication routing for receive, whereas stock restores charging profile and Case polling. Stock path does not select a distinct SBL/ROM entry option or hold a verified boot-override GPIO.
recoveryAssessment.remainingLimits: Actual Apollo reset, retail INFO configuration and windows within the driven train remain unobserved. Replacing stock driven intervals with input/UART would alter the waveform and is not qualified as a safe recovery test. No claim that every recovery possibility is excluded.
recoveryAssessment.hardwareDecision: Do not repeat same reset/HELLO or change baud/GPIO/protection merely because180-second timer elapsed; no firmware sent.

rapidUsbGesture.mechanism: Keeps two previous qualifying-edge counter values at0x2000010C/+4. On next qualifying event, if both history values nonzero and unsigned current-oldest<7, set A2 marker and event0x200. No distinct five-edge branch in this handler.
rapidUsbGesture.eventHandling: 0x0800700A..0x0800701C setsR0=1,R1=1, calls same0x08009A9C, clears event and calls NVIC_SystemReset.
rapidUsbGesture.startup: 0x080032CC checks A2; if1, 0x080038A0 alternates PA6/PA7 three times with200-tick waits and clears A2. Indicator acknowledgement, not a verified bootloader state.
rapidUsbGesture.documentedCounts: Three USB unplug/reconnect cycles within7seconds; five touchpad taps. Described as restart.
rapidUsbGesture.qualification: Counter tick cadence and physical edge polarity not independently measured; no physical gesture requested or executed this turn.
